title: Introducing apps in ChatGPT and the new Apps SDK
summary: We’re introducing a new generation of apps you can chat with, right inside ChatGPT. Developers can start building them today with the new Apps SDK, available in preview.
body: We’re introducing a new generation of apps you can chat with, right inside ChatGPT. Developers can start building them today with the new Apps SDK, available in preview.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了全新的ChatGPT内置应用功能，并向开发者发布了Apps SDK的预览版。新一代应用允许用户在ChatGPT对话界面内部直接与之交互，开发者可以利用全新的软件开发工具包即刻开始构建和扩展AI应用生态。

aiReview.reasonZh: ChatGPT引入了全新的内置应用及Apps SDK预览版，拓展了大模型的生态应用场景，属于重要发布。
